messages:
maria_finance: Quick ask — Garnet Health pilot: they underconsumed committed Dedicated capacity in Feb because rollout delayed. Sales wants to convert pilot to paid month; asking finance approval to issue one-time credit and temporary pilot rate for month 1. Details: invoice `inv-2026-0237`, billed $48,200. Request: 20% one-time credit + 10% promo for next two cycles. 

 theo_sales: @maria_finance cc @priya_ae this is urgent, can we do 20% credit on `inv-2026-0237` and offer a 10% discounted rate for the first 2 billing cycles? They will sign an annual MSA in ~2 weeks if we move quickly. 

 priya_ae: Customer says they can't pay full amount until we reconcile usage. They're asking to push terms to net-90 for this invoice if we don't credit. 

 billing_bot: Auto-note: invoice `inv-2026-0237` flagged for dispute by account Garnet Health on 2026-05-06. Current balance $48,200. 

 julian_legal: From legal: okay to change payment terms to net-60 internally; net-90 needs exec sign-off. Any nonstandard pricing needs deal-desk approval & an amendment to the MSA. 

 maria_finance: My proposal: apply one-time credit = 20% ($9,640) as a prorated usage credit against `inv-2026-0237`, extend payment terms to net-60 (not net-90), and grant a 10% promotional rate for the next two billing cycles. We keep cashflow protected while giving Sales a closeable offer. 

 theo_sales: Prefer credit to be non-refundable. Also want MSA amendment that rolls rates back to standard after the promo period. Can we do that? 

 julian_legal: Non-refundable language is fine. Draft language: "one-time credit shall be applied to the specified invoice and is non-refundable; promotional rates lapse after the agreed period; standard pricing resumes thereafter." I'll put in a short amendment template. 

 ops: If approved, I need a signed PO or written email from the customer and a finance ticket to issue the credit. @billing please queue CM creation once we have sign-off. 

 maria_finance: Tagging @charles_finance and @revops for final sign-off. If +1, I'll create credit memo and route to accounting. 

 charles_finance: :thumbsup: Approve 20% one-time credit and net-60 terms. We won't extend net-90 for new pilots. Approve 10% promo for two cycles. Please attach customer PO and legal amendment before issuing credit. 

 priya_ae: :tada: Customer verbally agreed on the call. I'll upload signed PO to the ticket within today and send the amendment for e-sign. 

 maria_finance: Thanks — I'll create credit memo `CM-2026-117` and update `inv-2026-0237` after we receive PO + amendment. Expected adjusted balance $38,560 due net-60. 

 billing_bot: Credit memo `CM-2026-117` created by maria_finance on 2026-05-07. Invoice `inv-2026-0237` adjusted; new balance $38,560, due net-60. Ticket: FIN-4482. 

 maria_finance: Closing loop: once PO & signed amendment in FIN-4482, billing will apply CM and send updated statement to customer. Thanks all.
